pages.text: This section describes how to import online playlists using the $(l:iammusicplayer:item_or_block_with_feature/music_manager)Music Management Computer$(/l). $(br)There are two methods.

pages.title: Create and Import a Playlist
pages.text: On the playlist creation screen, click the adjacent 'Add Online Playlist' button, choose the import method, fill in the required information, and click the [Import] button.

pages.title: Import Music into an Existing Playlist
pages.text: If you want to add a playlist created by other players, you can select from the playlists you can participate in.
